name: fontpool
description: Search Fontshare, Fontsource and Google as one catalog with categories, tags and foundry descriptions, then download woff2 files into your project and write the @font-face rules.
long_description:
Gives Claude three tools for working with type: list_fonts to search every family the providers carry between them — by category, use-case tag, variable axis or provider — font_properties to read one family's weights, styles, subsets, variable axes and the foundry's own description of the design, and install_font to download the actual woff2 files into a project folder and write the matching @font-face rules into a stylesheet.

Fonts are self-hosted — no CDN request at runtime. Built on unifont.

Adobe Fonts is deliberately not included: Adobe's terms require their fonts be loaded from their own CDN via a kit embed, so they can't be downloaded into a project.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: Searches every family the providers carry, filtered by category, use-case tag, variable axis or provider.

tools.name: font_properties
tools.description: Returns one family's weights, styles, subsets, variable axes, foundry and description.

tools.name: install_font
tools.description: Downloads a family's woff2 files into the project and writes the @font-face rules.
